territories.name: Samoa
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Samoa levies a value added goods and services tax of its own under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2015: the Ministry of Revenue administers it at a rate of 15 per cent, exports and the other supplies of Schedule 3 are zero-rated, the supplies of Schedule 2 (financial services among them) are exempt, and a registered person files a return, form VAGST 001, for each GST period of two months within 15 working days after its end.
